summary: Hertz Corp., a subsidiary of Hertz Global Holdings, filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $350M aggregate principal amount of 6.75% Exchangeable Senior First-Lien Secured PIK Notes due 2030, completed on June 29, 2026. The notes were issued at par under an indenture with Computershare Trust Company as trustee and collateral agent. Initial purchasers have a 13-day option to buy an additional $50M. The transaction creates a new debt obligation secured by first-lien collateral, with PIK interest feature. Proceeds likely used for general corporate or capital return purposes. Watch for note conversion dynamics, potential dilution from exchange, and the impact of the secured debt on capital structure.
